text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I knew I wouldn't be able to beat you<n>at arm
wrestling. You're just too<n>strong, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for a princess to<n>have this level of
strength! Now,<n>who's my next opponent?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, are you having an arm wrestling<n>tournament?
Count me in!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-you too, Pearl! Hnnngh! I didn't<n>expect you to
hold your own against<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, stop, you two! The floor is<n>making a weird
noise! Things are<n>gonna end badly if you keep
going!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I had no idea you werethis strong... You must have one...incredible training routine...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I just use what my trainertaught me about leveraging strength!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example, when I'm doing weight<n>training, I
focus on my form rather<n>than doing high reps!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, and you can see the results for<n>yourself. My
trainer is the ultimate<n>pearl that brightens my shine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Does that mean you're going<n>to grow even
stronger?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The possibilities are limitless<n>when it comes
to my trainer and me!<n>We're always aiming higher!
